toggleTooltip: Set TTFT / TPOT / walltime budgets checked against every simulation
panelHint: Green/red pass-fail badges with margin % appear on every simulation result
inputAria: {metric} in milliseconds or seconds per the unit shown
badgePassTooltip: {label} within budget ({budget} budgeted) — margin shown as % headroom
badgeFailTooltip: {label} exceeded the {budget} budget — overrun shown as % over
marginHint: Margin = (budget − actual) ÷ budget. Positive = headroom left, negative = over budget. Clear a field to disable that check. Budgets are saved in your browser.
resetTooltip: Restore the default budgets (TTFT 500 ms · TPOT 50 ms · walltime 10 s)
agenticOffenderSuffix: Turns {turns} exceed at least one SLO budget.
agenticAllPass: ✓ Every turn meets the SLO budgets
